movelist.name: Rock Slide
movelist.effect: Rock Slide Flinches all Legal Targets on 17+.

movelist.name: Take Down
movelist.effect: You may perform a Trip Maneuver against the target as a Free Action.

movelist.name: Curse
movelist.effect: If the user is not a Ghost Type, Curse has a Frequency of EOT, and when used the user lowers its Speed by -1 Combat Stage, but raises Attack and Defense by +1 Combat Stage each.  If the user is a Ghost Type, Curse has a Frequency of Scene, and when used the user loses 1/3rd of their Max Hit Points and a target Pokémon or Trainer within 8 meters of the user becomes Cursed. This Hit Point loss cannot be prevented in any way.

movelist.name: Earth Power
movelist.effect: Earth Power lowers the Special Defense of all Legal Targets 1 Combat Stage on 16+.

movelist.name: Lava Plume
movelist.effect: Lava Plume burns all targets on 16+.

movelist.name: Amnesia
movelist.effect: Raise the user’s Special Defense 2 Combat Stages.

abilities.name: White Flame
abilities.effect: The user may not make rolls to cure themselves from the Enraged condition. However, while Enraged, the user gains a +5 Bonus to all Damage Rolls.

abilities.name: Solid Rock
abilities.effect: The user gains +5 Damage Reduction against Super- Effective damage. Defensive.
